target.title: fix(sandbox): bound SSH command output buffering at 16 MiB
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `runSshSandboxCommand` in `src/agents/sandbox/ssh.ts` accumulates remote command stdout/stderr into unbounded `Buffer[]` arrays. A runaway or misconfigured remote command that produces excessive output (e.g. `cat /dev/urandom`, an infinite loop, or log dump) can exhaust the gateway process memory, leading to OOM.

## Why This Change Was Made

The change adds a 16 MiB combined stdout+stderr cap at the chokepoint (the `data` event handlers inside `runSshSandboxCommand`). When the cap is exceeded the child process is killed and the promise rejects with a descriptive error that includes the accumulated partial output. This matches the defensive bounding pattern already used elsewhere in the codebase (e.g. `MAX_POST_TOOL_CALL_BUFFER_BYTES` in the OpenAI transport stream, the pending Anthropic SSE response-bound PR).

No API surface or type change — the existing `SandboxBackendCommandResult` / `RunSshSandboxCommandParams` interfaces are unchanged. Callers that already handle rejection (all call sites in `ssh-backend.ts` use `await` with try-catch or `.catch`) receive the new error naturally.

## User Impact

- **Before:** A remote SSH command producing >16 MiB of output could grow the gateway heap unboundedly until OOM kills the process.
- **After:** Output is capped at 16 MiB. Exceeding that limit terminates the child process and surfaces a clear `Command output exceeded 16777216 byte limit` error, preserving the partial output collected up to the cap.

16 MiB is generous enough for legitimate use (file reads, build output) while preventing memory exhaustion from pathological commands.

## Evidence

### Real behavior proof (vitest, mocked spawn — external dep only)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/sandbox/ssh.output-bound.test.ts --run

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  5 passed (5)
```

Test coverage:
| Case | Result |
|------|--------|
| Normal output (<16 MiB) | stdout/stderr collected correctly, resolves |
| Single chunk >16 MiB | `child.kill("SIGTERM")` called, rejects with byte-limit error |
| Many small chunks crossing 16 MiB | cap triggers on combined total, kills process |
| Partial output preserved | error object carries `stdout`/`stderr` buffers up to cap |
| Post-cap data ignored | chunks arriving after `outputCapped=true` are not accumulated |

### Negative control (pre-fix main code, same test)

```
$ git show origin/main:src/agents/sandbox/ssh.ts > src/agents/sandbox/ssh.ts
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/sandbox/ssh.output-bound.test.ts --run

 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  4 failed | 1 passed (5)
```

All four cap-related tests fail: `child.kill` is never called (no cap), output accumulates unboundedly, and the promise resolves instead of rejecting. Only the normal-output test passes.

### Existing tests preserved

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/sandbox/ssh.test.ts --run

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  28 passed (28)
```

All 28 existing SSH sandbox tests continue to pass with no changes.
